items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I used to play certain parties and dances for him... George Uge played there all the summer. And, that's where I did a lot of playing

ctx.x: us a pretty good idea of the kind of training that you had before you went to 'Bama State. But, what kind of opportunities for music making had you had from the time that you began playing around 7, up until the time that you went to 'Bama State?
Well, there (inaudible) used to be a band leader there. I can't recall his name right now. It may come to me later. He used to play out the "Tuxedo Junction". George Uge was the name.
